title_as_printed: A new nomogram model for the individualized prediction of mild cognitive impairment in elderly patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus
blind_first: blind codes were written to this file before the registry codes file was opened

blind_codes.Validation_Type: V2 (bootstrap internal validation on the original sample only)

Task_Type.reason: Cross-sectional logistic-regression nomogram discriminating current MCI (MoCA < 26) from normal cognition in elderly T2DM inpatients; AUC 0.893, sensitivity 0.785, specificity 0.850.

Category.reason: Clinical/questionnaire variables: education, diabetes duration, GDS-5 depression, HbA1c (routine clinical lab value), 4-m walking speed, sedentary time; MoCA/MMSE outcome.

Validation_Type.reason: Internal validation by 1000-replicate bootstrap on the original single-hospital sample; no held-out test set and no external validation (authors state this limitation, p. 9).

ADNI_Dependent.reason: Qilu Hospital of Shandong University inpatients; ADNI not used.
